name: Thule's Head
summary: At the Sepulcher, High Executor Hadrec demands proof that Thule Ravenclaw is dead. His severed head confirms the commander of the Scourge forces on Fenris Isle has fallen and helps the Forsaken hold Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: Trophy of Fenris Isle
sections.body: Fenris Isle is the Lich King's chief Scourge stronghold in Silverpine Forest. From Fenris Keep, the necromancer Thule Ravenclaw commands rot hides and undead minions that threaten Forsaken outposts, including the Sepulcher. High Executor Hadrec will accept no report of Thule's death without his severed head. When Thule dies, dark magic surges through the woods. His head gives Hadrec the proof he needs to declare Fenris Isle broken.

aliases: who turned in thule head to
faq.answer: High Executor Hadrec, who commands Forsaken forces from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, demands Thule's Head as proof that the Scourge leader is dead.
Thule Ravenclaw is a powerful necromancer who commands the Scourge on Fenris Isle. From Fenris Keep, he directs attacks against the Forsaken and wields enchantments such as the Hex of the Ravenclaw.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken demand his head specifically?
aliases: why do they want his head
faq.answer: The Forsaken cannot leave Silverpine threatened by the Scourge. Necromancers are notorious for deceit and dark resurrections, so High Executor Hadrec demands physical proof that Thule is destroyed.

faq.q: What happens when Thule Ravenclaw is slain?
faq.answer: When Thule Ravenclaw is slain, necrotic energy bursts across the region. Forsaken scholars and apothecaries at the Sepulcher can sense the magical shockwave from afar.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, severing Thule's head is a military victory and personal vengeance against the Lich King's hold on Lordaeron.
Thule Ravenclaw's death secures Silverpine Forest's eastern borders and shields newly gained Horde territory from Scourge attacks.
